newsitem.title: USA: US PSA recommends early close Fri, full close Mon.
newsitem.headline: US PSA recommends early close Fri, full close Mon.

text.p: PSA The Bond market Trade Association has recommended an early close on Friday at 1400 EST/1900 GMT ahead of the Martin Luther King Jr Day holiday on Monday.
PSA also recomended a full close on Monday in observance of the holiday.

Markets in U.S. government securities, mortgages, over-the-counter investment grade corporate bonds, municipal bonds and secondary money market trading in bankers acceptances, commercial paper and Yankee and Euro certificates of deposit would be affected.
As always, the early close will not affect the closing time for settlements.
